conventions.score: numerator of the report's 'x/14' pressure/confluence score
conventions.zfp: Zone Failure Probability in percent as printed; null if the report gives none (zfp_range holds printed ranges)
conventions.side: RES / EQ / SUP mapped from the report's zone name or Supply/Demand type (pine 'MID' -> EQ); null where the source gives no side
conventions.e2_chain.from/to: numbers only when the report prints an explicit range/target for that day; otherwise null with from_zone/to_zone [bottom, top] where the report names zones
conventions.e3_setups.tp: TP1 where several TPs are printed (tp2/tp3 as extra keys); for entry ranges, entry = first listed sub-level and 'entries' holds all
